7084-8249-8293.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

4186-4279-7173.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-7173.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Virulent Emissary trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1981-2415-2842-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Blood Artist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3755-4770-4885-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5256-6982--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When that creature enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6797-7452.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.

1017-1494-5636-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Wizard Class triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2438-5434-5555-7666.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2438-5434-5555-7666.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

240-5470-6797-6968.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2281-3967-6132.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Saffi triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2511-2781-6767.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Rescue Skiff
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Rescue Skiff
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

2963-4772-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
2963-4772-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Doubling Season.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a mana-producing land you control

1399-2597-3814.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Wild Growth triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the land tapped in step 1 and Wirewood Lodge.
Repeat.
1399-2597-3814.notes: If the land taps for {G}, you can get infinite {G} and then untap another land instead in step 4.

560-2457-4068-4289.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
560-2457-4068-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1308-1563-2457-4359.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

3476-3967-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2307-2713-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Corsair Captain.
When Corsair Captain enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

802-1980-2493-3558-5326.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{B}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
802-1980-2493-3558-5326.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{B}.
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} and commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Archaeomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Snap to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting The Master.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Snap, targeting Ornithopter.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Ornithopter to your hand from the battlefield, and untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{B}.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning The Master to your hand from the battlefield, and untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

1189-1400-4957.description:
Whenever a creature enters the battlefield, Spreading Plague triggers, destroying all creatures, as they all black due to Darkest Hour.
Because Eldrazi Monument gives your creatures indestructible, only your opponents' creatures are destroyed.

560-2067-3858.notablePrerequisites: Your life total plus the number of creatures you control is equal to or greater than eighteen.
560-2067-3858.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

1329-2816-4659-5034.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Emry.
Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2816-4659-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sol Ring, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sol Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sol Ring from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Activate Emry by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

538-2459-2906-5147.notablePrerequisites: The amount of life opponents have lost this turn is equal to or greater than Rograkh's commander tax.
538-2459-2906-5147.description:
Cast Rograkh for {0}.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Impact Tremors, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh, to deal one damage to any target.
Choose to put Rograkh in the command zone.
Repeat.

228-4013-4659-4840.description:
Spend {2}{C} to activate Eldrazi Displacer's ability targeting Myr Battlesphere.
Myr Battlesphere ETBs, creating 4 Myr tokens.
Sacrifice two tokens to Krark-Clan Ironworks for 4 {C}.
Use the mana to activate Eldrazi Displacer's ability, targeting the Battlesphere.
Repeat for infinite Myr tokens and colorless mana.
Equip Skullclamp to some of your infinite tokens using some of your infinite mana to draw as many cards as you wish.

328-791-933-1494.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to black times the number of opponents you have is greater than or equal to 15.
328-791-933-1494.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Gray Merchant of Asphodel.
When Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Unspeakable Symbol five times by paying 15 life, putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
